code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sep=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Divider color is the color forming complete separator lines.
    rowcuts=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==sep for v in row)]
    colcuts=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n,cuts):
        out=[]; s=0
        for k in cuts:
            if k>s: out.append((s,k))
            s=k+1
        if s<n: out.append((s,n))
        return out
    rs,cs=spans(h,rowcuts),spans(w,colcuts)
    vals=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=sep)
    base=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=vals.most_common()[-1][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]==marker for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))>=2 else base for x,y in cs] for a,b in rs]
'''

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    candidates=set(v for row in grid for v in row if any(all(x==v for x in row) for row in grid) or any(all(grid[r][c]==v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))
    # Divider color appears as complete horizontal or vertical lines.
    sep=max(candidates,key=lambda v: sum(all(x==v for x in row) for row in grid)+sum(all(grid[r][c]==v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)))
    rowcuts=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==sep for v in row)]
    colcuts=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n,cuts):
        out=[]; s=0
        for k in cuts:
            if k>s: out.append((s,k))
            s=k+1
        if s<n: out.append((s,n))
        return out
    rs,cs=spans(h,rowcuts),spans(w,colcuts)
    vals=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=sep)
    base=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]; marker=vals.most_common()[-1][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]==marker for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))>=2 else base for x,y in cs] for a,b in rs]
'''
